tasks.taskText: With the YAML 1.1 schema (YAML11_SCHEMA), timestamps whose year is between 0000 and 0099 are not recognized: load("- 0001-01-01\n- 0050-06-15T12:30:00Z", { schema: YAML11_SCHEMA }) returns plain strings instead of Date objects, and a Date in that range does not survive dump followed by load. Make such date-only and full timestamps resolve to Date values whose UTC year is the literal four-digit year written in the document (year 1, year 50), with calendar validation still rejecting dates that Date would normalize such as 0001-02-29 (which must stay a string, and must raise "cannot resolve" when tagged !!timestamp explicitly). Behavior for years 0100 and later must not change. Source is under src/ (TypeScript); the package is built with npm run build and tests run with node --test "test/core/**/*.test.mjs" "test/spec/*.test.mjs".

visible.source:
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { load, YAML11_SCHEMA } from 'js-yaml'
const date = load('0050-06-15T12:30:00Z', { schema: YAML11_SCHEMA })
assert.ok(date instanceof Date, 'year 0050 must resolve to a Date')
assert.equal(date.getUTCFullYear(), 50)
console.log('visible check passed')
